# HR Industry Segments & Business Models

| Segment | Workforce pattern | HR operating emphasis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Advanced manufacturing | Factories or parks, multiple sites, blue-collar and technical roles, shifts and overtime | Bulk recruitment, onboarding, shift attendance, overtime, plant transfer and rule-based payroll |
| Chain retail and catering | Distributed stores, direct/franchise mix, part-time staff and high turnover | Mobile attendance, scheduling, rapid join/leave processing and headquarters aggregation |
| Logistics, warehousing and express | Networks, warehouses, routes, field work and seasonal peaks | Site/field attendance, flexible staffing, multi-location employee records and payroll closure |
| Hotels and tourism | 24/7 service, seasonal demand and multiple properties | Recruitment, scheduling, attendance, overtime and cross-property transfers |
| Software, IT and professional services | Knowledge workers, project or hybrid work and talent competition | AI-assisted recruitment, OKR/KPI, remote work and performance data integration |
